get.summary: ComputeHash computes the hash for a name, salt, and committer address

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name is the name to compute the hash for.

parameters.name: salt
parameters.description: salt is the salt to use for the hash computation.

get.summary: QueryNamesByDestination queries all names pointing to a destination address

parameters.name: destination

get.summary: Params queries the nameservice module parameters

ResolveName resolves a name to address or returns the address if already
valid

parameters.name: name_or_address
parameters.description: name_or_address is either a nameservice name or a valid address

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

reverse.description:
reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending
order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

hex_hash.title: hex_hash is the computed hash as a hex string

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.ComputeHash.title: ComputeHashResponse contains the computed hash as a hex string

bid_timeout.title:
bid_timeout defines the duration after which a bid can be claimed by the
bidder

allowed_denoms.title:
allowed_denoms defines the denominations that are allowed to be used for
valuations and bids

reject_bid_valuation_fee_percent.title:
reject_bid_valuation_fee_percent defines the percentage of the new
valuation to charge as a fee when rejecting a bid

minimum_bid_percent_increase.title:
minimum_bid_percent_increase defines the minimum percentage increase
required for a new bid compared to the previous bid
